source_text: Newborn male circumcision is associated with a reduced incidence of urinary tract infections (UTIs) in the first year of life, with meta-analyses indicating a relative risk reduction of about 90%, from approximately 1% in uncircumcised boys to 0.1-0.2% in circumcised ones. [53] [54]
